function setupObserver(host): void;

Defined in: website/components/carousel/awards-carousel/observer.ts:22

Autoplay only runs while ≥50% of the carousel is on screen (threshold [0, 0.5] gives a clean two-state signal); below that or under reduced-motion it pauses — offscreen animation would burn frames the user can't see. When IntersectionObserver itself is absent (very old engines, some test DOMs) the carousel degrades to always-visible so content still shows.

host

AwardsCarousel
